items.claim: Rizvan Kuniev's primary inclination is to offensively wrestle.
items.quote: Typically, he wants to offensively wrestle.

items.claim: Jailton Almeida attempted eight takedowns against Rizvan Kuniev and failed to secure any of them.
items.quote: Jailton Almeida, who you people said is awful, came in there, shot a [__] ton of takedowns, eight to be exact, and got none of them.

items.claim: Tyrell Fortune's takedown defense is not great and he can be taken down.
items.quote: The issue is his takedown defense is not great. He can be taken down.

items.claim: Damian Respecki shoots his takedowns low, below the hips, making it easier to finish them.
items.quote: When he shoots, he shoots nice and low. He's not shooting like half upper body. He's not even shooting at the hips. He's shooting below the hips, so it's a lot easier for him to run right through and finish those takedowns.
